top5_ignore: Un-throttled or 'complete' liquidation feeds: they do not exist; every vendor reads the same 1/s/symbol stream

diagnosis.breadth: saturated: 696 symbols of daily perp data since 2019, 7 449 official events, ~25 000 liquidations per day, 174 + 56 event universes already frozen; every rejection of the last three looks was a well-measured zero, not a small sample
diagnosis.quality: verified: timestamps to the second (publication minute carries the pump; first Vision bar = launch minute; liquidation crash starts in the publication minute), positive controls recover injected effects within 3 %, ledgers hash-chained
diagnosis.spectrum: what is missing is the STATE around each event: the external reference price (index), leverage crowding (OI, funding), depth (capacity), and the two body-text timestamps that decide executability. The looks measured returns against BTC with declared costs because the dataset had nothing else. That is a spectrum gap, not a breadth or quality gap.

minimum_dataset_before_any_new_test.name: event_window_state_v1
minimum_dataset_before_any_new_test.unit: one row per (event, minute) from t0 - 60 min to t0 + 24 h
must_have: bookDepth 1-min at 1/2.5/5 % where Vision has it, else null with a coverage flag
exact status timestamps (announced launch, first trade, delisting minute, SETTLING)

every future listing/delisting caught by the event-tape timer
minimum_dataset_before_any_new_test.rule: built by pure functions of the frozen universes; hashed; no return computed by the builder; no look without a preregistration and budget > 0

forbidden_data: any price look on the frozen universes without a new preregistration and budget > 0 (budget is 0)
re-testing H2 / H3 / forced-flow at another horizon on the same events
conditioning variables chosen after seeing per-event returns
more klines breadth as a substitute for state
recommendation: Build event_window_state_v1 from Binance Vision + the announcement-body/status layer for the two frozen universes and for every future event, before any new alpha research. It costs nothing, it is hashable, and it is the only thing that changes what the existing hypotheses can say. Budget stays 0 until new independent episodes arrive; the H3 forward seal is the only clock running.
